entities.summary: Allan Roy Edwards was a Canadian professional ice hockey goaltender who played 236 games in the National Hockey League with the Detroit Red Wings and the Pittsburgh Penguins between 1967 and 1973. Internationally, he played for the Canadian national team at the 1958 World Championships, winning the gold medal.
